messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service="model-catalog-config" severity=high — error-rate spike and validation failures observed in default promotion pipeline. PD: https://pd.example.com/incidents/P12345

pagerduty-bot: Page fired -> P12345. Escalation policy: oncall -> eng-sre.

Maya: acked. I'm oncall, pulling context. Can someone +1 if this is related to recent autopromote rollout?

Priya: yep saw it. Autopromote pushed rev 3.2.1 as default for `text-gen` models ~09:12 UTC. We're seeing tokenization errors in production requests that use the legacy tokenizer.

Alex: confirmed — promotion job flipped `default_revision` for `text-gen/small` at 09:12 UTC. The revision includes new tokenizer metadata (tokenizer=v2) but some routes still expect tokenizer=v1.

Maya: sample user error from logs: ```json
{"request_id":"9f2b3c","model":"text-gen/small","rev":"3.2.1","error":"TokenizerError: unknown token 'Ġ' at pos 14","status":500}
```

Javier: that looks like a tokenizer mismatch, not a model binary crash. Likely downstream routing picked up the new default but runtime config still enforces tokenizer=v1 for some customers. Might be during gradual rollout where route binding lagged.

Priya: +1. Also seeing bad defaults for `kv_cache_size` on 3.2.1 causing higher memory usage on some nodes which increases p50 latency. Two issues colliding.

Lena: Support reports — customer AcmeCorp and ZenithApps have active incidents, both reporting 5xx responses starting ~09:15 UTC. I'll queue a customer update once we know mitigation.

Maya: mitigation plan: 1) revert catalog default to previous safe rev (3.2.0) 2) enable fallback routing to tokenizer-v1 variant for impacted routes 3) roll back autopromote config and add hold 4) notify customers & PD update. Who can run the catalog revert?

Alex: I can run the revert now. Command I'll use:```bash
rwd catalog set-default --model text-gen/small --revision 3.2.0 --reason "emergency revert: tokenizer/kv defaults causing 5xx"
```

deploy-bot: Starting catalog transition job job_id=job-6789. Logs: https://ci.example.com/jobs/job-6789

Javier: while that's running I'll patch runtime routing to prefer explicit tokenizer variant if available. Patch:```yaml
# runtime routing override
route_overrides:
  - model: text-gen/small
    prefer_variant: tokenizer-v1
```

Priya: I'll reduce `kv_cache_size` default on 3.2.1 variant to avoid OOM pressure while we stabilize. Applying safe defaults now.

Maya: deploy-bot shows job-6789 completed, default is now 3.2.0. Can we confirm error rate dropped?

Priya: metrics: error-rate for text-gen/small 5xx down from 4.8% -> 0.3% over last 2 minutes. Latency p50 back to baseline.

Lena: Posted initial customer note: "We've identified a regression from a newly-promoted model revision that caused tokenization mismatches for some workloads. Default has been reverted and a fix is in progress. We'll follow up when stable."

Maya: handoff to eng-sre for verification & post-change checks. Javier, Priya — I'm handing the incident to you for 30m triage and postmortem. I'm stepping off-call. @Javier please ack. :point_right:

Javier: acked. Taking lead for follow-up. I'll run end-to-end checks and validate rollout guard rails.

Alex: I've disabled autopromote pipeline for the affected catalog group and added a temporary pre-deploy validation to detect tokenizer metadata mismatches. Patch link: https://git.example.com/redwood/catalog/commit/abc123

Priya: Confirmed runtime routing override is active and `kv_cache_size` patched on suspicious nodes. Monitoring for memory spikes.

Javier: quick checklist I'm running: 1) ensure no nodes running 3.2.1 as default 2) verify routing table fallbacks 3) check canary percent on next promotions 4) add regression test to preflight.

Maya: thanks all. PD status update: P12345 -> acknowledged -> mitigated (default reverted + routing fallback). Leaving notes for postmortem. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Resolution recorded for P12345: mitigations applied, monitoring OK. Incident severity downgraded.

Lena: I'll follow up with affected customers with the timeline and next steps.

Javier: scheduling postmortem doc and action items: - stronger pre-promote validations for tokenizer metadata - autopromote kill-switch with canary hold - add tokenization compatibility unit to model onboarding checklist.

Maya: closing handoff. If anything regresses ping PD again. Great reaction time — nice work. :tada:

Priya: :clap:

Alex: will open a release note and link the postmortem when available.

deploy-bot: job-6789 artifacts archived.

incident-bot: thread closed.
